style: Refine every catalog object toward warm, softly lit cartoon art, consistent with the selected plant reference. Preserve identity, function and original palette family. Keep registered camera, dimensions, roots, sockets, ports, footprints and animation timing. No preferred horizontal light direction for rotatable world sprites; no directional ground shadows. Real 3D render output, editable Blender sources. The source 2D effects remain explicitly identified as 2D. Each object receives fresh independent editor/judge agents. Publish object-by-object to the same PR preview; integrate approved sprites into Godot after catalog review checks. Follow-on design exploration: improve the modeling itself, including forms, proportions, structure, crafted details and decorations. Original part counts and awkward geometry are not constraints. The editor may rebuild native geometry to achieve the better design; the judge should reward useful improvements. Preserve the locked registration, gameplay contact/clearance, animation and modular continuity contract. See modeling-policy.json version2.

qualityCriteria.origin: Fresh independent source/target/native inspection; no editor proposal or sibling aesthetic review was read.

referenceAuthority.priority: Locked native functional/registration/continuity contract governs target conflicts. Target guides visible design; approved family governs exact common material/render/consumer continuity. W's actual native orientation and UV mapping govern this object's direction.

visibleOutcomes.required: The conveyor has soft but definite coral rail volume and distinct rounded blue slat shoulders rather than flat rigid bands. Support construction feels intentional, stable and crafted inside the footprint and height envelope. Interior structure and nonconnecting decoration may improve freely; original topology and part count are not success criteria.
visibleOutcomes.inspect: Every facing at normal128 cell, reduced55 and32 cell, and enlarged source pixels; all unique frames and closure.

visibleOutcomes.required: Coral rails, blue-slate deck, honey/amber wood and restrained brass remain separate and readable. Use the exact approved common family response. Wood must not collapse into near-black exposed blocks, and slate must not merge with rail undersides. The object belongs beside approved N/E/S family pieces without a color or contrast jump.
visibleOutcomes.inspect: Light, neutral gray, dark, transparent and actual restaurant floor contexts; isolated and mixed routes at the same scale and registration.

visibleOutcomes.required: Broad controlled highlights and readable midtones communicate softly lit cartoon volume. No sharp white glare, clipped blooms, dead black patches, flat unshaded faces, preferred horizontal lighting direction or directional ground cast shadow. Every facing has an equally coherent surface treatment using the same approved lights, world and render response.
visibleOutcomes.inspect: Rail edges/undersides, deck seams, wood feet and native cut planes in all100 direction/frame captures, including native and independent assemblies.

visibleOutcomes.required: Visible wood/support/fastener construction adds purposeful craft without noisy microtexture or ornament clutter. Detail may differ from ImageGen and need not have a prescribed count. Useful detail reads at128/55; at32 the warm support, deck/rail separation and stable silhouette remain clear even when individual fasteners naturally simplify.
visibleOutcomes.prohibitedTargetCopies: No collars, cap bars, closing rollers, protruding fasteners or overhangs at the open connection planes. The ImageGen gold end collars are not required and cannot override the flush native cross-section.

visibleOutcomes.required: No material defects or dead spots in required views: black blotches, pinholes, coplanar overlap, bright join lines, dark repeated cuts, broken corners, clipping, floating supports, exposed unintended ends, hard shading discontinuities, alpha halos or swimming texture. At cell32 the moving conveyor remains identifiable and its structure is coherent in the actual phone consumer.
visibleOutcomes.inspect: Full-image inspection, enlarged defects and ordinary-size moving routes; do not inspect joins alone.

visibleOutcomes.required: Seven periods per cell move in this W source's actual directed flow at24 frames/12fps and close smoothly. Stationary construction stays fixed. The repeated route and port-compatible mixed routes have continuous deck/rail profile, material cadence and phase through both boundaries for every facing and frame. No frame pop, speed reversal, phase reset, join shimmer or alternating module tint.

hardConstraints.sourceIdentity: Own native source, exact named W collection and root, editable geometry and actual source-derived node action. Inspect the candidate .blend and all external/packed/linked resource closure; bind each relevant file to the candidate packet hash. No target cards, raster imitation, baked target texture, source mutation or unbound dependency.

cameraRegistration.requiredProof: Compare native camera world/projection matrices with source-camera.json and approved family settings; numerically project origin/unitX/unitDepth/unitHeight. Source2 values must remain approximately root192,496; X256,0; depth0,256; height0,-179.2, with only recorded float serialization tolerance. One camera, framing, materials and grade across all facings; no per-view fitting, alpha fitting, resizing or pixel correction. Raw active35degree camera is not authoritative.

nativeGeometry.requiredProof: Unhide object/collection/layer viewport/render/exclude state and update depsgraph before measuring evaluated mesh bounds and cut vertices. Compare both W source end profiles, socket, root and full geometry envelope numerically; use1e-6 modeling tolerance where appropriate. Do not substitute N's different world-axis profile for W. No decorative material/geometry interrupts or exceeds connection profiles. Native changes inside the locked functional envelope are encouraged.

orientationAndPorts.requiredProof: Derive actual candidate UV0/UV1 world endpoints and flow from its own W mesh/transform chain, then project every publisher facing. Equivalent native rebuilding is allowed only with proof of these same resulting ports, flow and coordinate response. Do not blindly reuse Nπ/Eπ/2/S0 child orientation.

animation.atlasFrameOrder: row-major0..23 with original rects; duplicate closure is evidence only
animation.UV: Actual Flow UV.x0 incoming→1 outgoing; original quad loop UVs[0,0],[0,1],[1,1],[1,0].
animation.requiredProof: Inspect action owner/slot/F-curves, all25 evaluated phases, graph links and UV-to-world mapping. Native reopen-and-evaluate must work without a hidden pose callback. Prove closure and visible motion, not merely distinct PNG hashes.

commonFamily.requiredProof: Retain exact common five material graph topology, values, ramps and response, profile, seven-period repeat, native phase, lighting/world and render settings from approved family. The W moving material keeps W action ownership. Prove W-specific coordinate bases produce the same transverse rail localX±.065/localZ±.095 and deck UV phase response; renaming or rotating a graph without native coordinate evidence is insufficient. Native procedural shading is acceptable; target-image mapping or per-view regrade is not.

candidateEvidence.immutablePacket: Hash-bound .blend, recipe, native inspection, every required source image/atlas, previews, validation, source records, family settings and runtime/resource closure. Judge review binds the exact packet SHA256; missing evidence is needs_evidence.
candidateEvidence.isolatedFrames: All4facings×24 unique native frames plus closure for each facing. Supply original-layout atlases, frame-indexed readable sheets, actual transparency and normal-size playback at12fps. All sources must share the registered contract.
candidateEvidence.assemblies: Native connected three-module WWW and independently assembled copies for all4 facings/all24+closure. Include port-compatible mixed approvedN-W-N and W-approvedN-W routes in both boundary orders with explicit native placements, rotations, UV direction, phase and directed port correspondence. Include representative compatible E/S sibling contact coverage. A90degree geometric crossing between straight pieces is not a valid join test.
candidateEvidence.consumer: Render independent sprites and corresponding native connected references through the exact approved N11 Godot consumer files, with hash proof and actual project/backend/settings evidence. Cell sizes128/55/32; several fractional floor/camera offsets including both axis fractions; transparent/light/gray/dark and actual restaurant-floor contexts. Exercise all4 facings, all24+closure and required same/mixed routes. Include actual application floor/phone evidence and playable motion, not only Pillow interpolation or a replacement sampling path.
candidateEvidence.residuals: Quantify full-image and localized join RGB plus alpha residuals between native connected reference and independent assembly in the actual consumer. Give maxima, changed pixel counts, support/domain, worst-case route/facing/frame/cell/fraction/background, coordinates/bounds and an indexed image or heatmap for residual locations. Examine premultiplied RGB/compositing correctly and include opaque backgrounds. No blanket pass from matching alpha, a low join-only number, max≤N, a tiny area claim or sibling approval.
candidateEvidence.materialityReview: Any tiny interior residual may be accepted only after this judge visibly inspects the actual localized pixels and normal-size motion/context and explicitly records why it has no material effect. Full-frame differences cannot be hidden by cropping to joins; a concentrated visible defect still blocks even if averages are small. Exact numerical identity is not a substitute for visual style/defect review.
candidateEvidence.nativeResourceProof: Reopen exact candidate bytes, confirm mesh/source ownership and dependency closure, assigned W action/slot and25 evaluated phases, evaluated bounds/profiles/ports/UV coordinate bases and native camera calibration. Reproduce representative captured pixels from the source. Bind exact common-family settings and approved consumer hashes, including production mapping; do not certify undeclared resources by manifest alone.

judgmentPolicy.approve: Only when the actual exports visibly improve toward the frozen aesthetic, meet exact common family continuity and all native technical constraints, and have no material defects/dead spots in required views, assemblies or motion. Scores support observations; no universal threshold.
judgmentPolicy.revise: At most three ranked blockers with visible location, effect and desired outcome. Reward useful native design changes without demanding literal source or ImageGen topology.
judgmentPolicy.needsEvidence: Required visual/native/runtime/hash/registration proof absent or unverified. Missing evidence never counts as a pass.
judgmentPolicy.authority: Only the coordinator can freeze these criteria into brief.qualityCriteria. This file itself grants no candidate approval, source promotion, publication or deployment permission.

delivery.scope: Refine this object only. Root coordinator promotes approved atlases, sources and metadata to production, publishes the PR preview, and finally updates Godot.
delivery.notes: Write source/round-NN.blend or the actual native 2D source as appropriate; full native captures, original-layout atlases, previews, validation and delivery.json. Do not label 2D artwork as a Blender model.
